name: Terrain Press
summary: Turn real NASA elevation data into 3D-printable ornaments and jigsaw puzzles.
description: Pick a place on Earth, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Ceres, Vesta, Venus, Pluto or the gas giants, choose a shape and a size, and download print-ready STL and 3MF files. Everything is computed in the browser from real spacecraft measurements; nothing is uploaded anywhere.

distributions.label: Install offline copy
distributions.notes: The site/ folder with the bundled elevation data (about 300 MB).
